Marissa / Kimberly,

Thanks for the update and the certificate, Sophie — appreciated. A couple of internal clarifications from Finance before we reissue: 

- We need to verify the certificate shows HelioPay's taxable establishment in France (registration alone is usually enough, but the certificate should include effective registration date and legal trading name). Can someone confirm that the PDF has those fields? Sophie — if the certificate is a standard FR VAT cert, this should be fine.
- Our collections policy requires a signed self-billing agreement on file before we classify the invoice as reverse-charge for accounting. If Helio will sign, Finance will reissue the invoice net and mark it accordingly; otherwise we'll keep the original gross invoice and follow our normal collection path.
- Pending receipt of the signed agreement, please place a short payment-release hold for this transaction in our AR system and flag for manual review (expected hold duration: up to 7 business days). 

Marissa — can you confirm whether the attached VAT certificate contains the effective registration date and legal entity name? Kimberly — if we decide to proceed with self-billing, Finance will need the signed DocuSign PDF in the billing folder to close the loop.
